verdict.rationale: Oyster documents a broad public API that covers core UI workflows: creating and submitting EOR employments, verifying agreements for signature, provisioning benefits, retrieving engagements, bonuses and allowances, and acting on behalf of customers as a reseller. There is no explicit claim of API/UI parity, and several UI capabilities have no shown API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement, API coverage evidence for payroll, expenses and time-off management, salary/compensation data and the cost calculator, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: create a draft EOR employment, update the job details, and submit the employment to kick off the employment onboarding and contract generation.
Request benefits: Provisions benefits for an engagement.
Retrieve all engagements: Returns a list of engagements
This guide will help Resellers use the API to manage their customers and take actions on their behalf.
